ROOT_CAUSE: Two independent axes, neither of them the threshold. (1) POSITION: BTN_OPEN_INTEL_WILD_HUD is the world-map HUD menu button at x_norm 0.925, and the right-hand button stack is bottom-anchored, so its row depends on which other buttons the client is currently drawing -- y_norm 0.6727 in one layout and 0.7453 in another, 93 px apart. The record used its registration ROI as the search window, so on the six 2026-09-16 failures the phash crop landed on empty sky (distance 34-38 against a threshold of 24) while the control was demonstrably on screen lower down (phash distance 2, ccoeff 0.945). A ROI cannot be both 'where it is' and 'where to look'. (2) THEME: the day/night cycle repaints the HUD, and the single day-colour template scored only 0.390-0.448 on the two night MAP frames even though the control was at the registered position. The work order's hypothesis (animated variant / template coverage) is partly right -- coverage was one of two gaps -- but the dominant cause is geometry, which no template can fix.
PATCH_SUMMARY: vision.py: the opt-in ccoeff branch now takes an optional per-record ``search_band`` as the window (margin 0) and reports the bounds it FOUND rather than the registration ROI -- because the executor taps match.center_norm, and reporting the registration would have sent the live tap 93 px above the button. Reporting found bounds is what _find_anywhere already does. matchers.py was not touched: the existing ``margin`` parameter covers the window width. Manifest: the three records of this one semantic gained matcher=ccoeff and search_band {0.72, 0.30, 0.28, 0.55}; two night templates were cropped from the archived night frames at their measured position. No threshold was changed (semantic_max_distance stays 24) and no route/backend was changed.

It pins the three things the fix depends on -- the six failure frames resolve, the reported centre follows the FOUND row (0.7453) rather than the registration row (0.6727), the night frames resolve, control-absent pages refuse, the threshold is still 24, and every template of this semantic carries the band (a template added later without it would silently fall back to the ROI, which is exactly the state that produced the failures).

The two populations OVERLAP (worst positive 29 vs best negative 28), so no threshold reaches 100% recall with zero false positives. Threshold deliberately left at 24: 25-28 would add 2 positives but the margin to the nearest negative frame becomes 0-3 px, which is the marginal-threshold move the order forbids.
